description: Defines classes and methods for socket communication in shared memory management, including socket creation, connection, data transmission, and server-client socket handling.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Base class for UNIX domain socket communication, handling socket creation, data sending/receiving, and address preparation.

classes.name: ManagerSocket
classes.description: Derived class for managing socket communication with shared memory manager, including receiving allocation info and confirming.

classes.name: ManagerServerSocket
classes.description: Server-side socket class that binds, listens, accepts connections, and manages socket file removal.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Client-side socket class for connecting to server socket, registering allocations and deallocations.

methods.name: prepare_address
methods.description: Prepares UNIX socket address structure with given path.

methods.name: address_length
methods.description: Calculates length of socket address structure.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives data over socket, handling polling and errors.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data over socket, handling partial writes.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection and returns a ManagerSocket.

methods.name: register_allocation
methods.description: Registers an allocation with the shared memory manager.

methods.name: register_deallocation
methods.description: Registers deallocation with the shared memory manager.
